node.statement: Subject to the explicit validation requirement on node 1.2, that node gives R_Y in S_{I_{n+1} tensor Q,I_{n+1} tensor P} and C_X in S_{I_{n+1} tensor P,I_{n+1} tensor Q}. Thus, inside the single square amplification M_{n+1} tensor A, the first factor has right projection I_{n+1} tensor P equal to the second factor s left projection, so (R_Y,C_X) is a compatible amplified rectangular pair in the precise sense required by lem-compcb-rectangular-product-CONTRACT.
